::: {.cgp-footer}

```{ojs}
// The notice comes from config/site.toml through meta.json: a shared prefix
// followed by one clause per chain actually present in the capture, so a reader
// is never disclaimed at about a chain this page cannot show them. A chain that
// wants something changed can open an issue or write in.
//
// The address is put together here, in the reader's browser, from its parts.
// Neither this source nor the page Quarto renders from it holds the address
// whole, or a mail link to it, so a crawler harvesting addresses from the HTML
// finds nothing to take; a reader sees an ordinary link.
siteFooter = {
  const repo = (meta.releases && meta.releases.all
    ? meta.releases.all.replace(/\/releases.*$/, "")
    : "https://github.com/coatless-data/club-gas-prices");
  const address = ["support", ["caffeinatedmath", "com"].join(".")].join("@");
  const mail = html`<a href=${"mail" + "to:" + address}>${address}</a>`;
  return html`<div>
    ${(Array.isArray(meta.notice) ? meta.notice : [meta.notice])
      .map((line) => html`<p class="cgp-footer-notice">${line}</p>`)}
    <p class="cgp-footer-notice">Represent one of these chains and want something changed or
      removed? <a href=${repo + "/issues/new"}>Open an issue</a> on GitHub or email ${mail}.</p>
  </div>`;
}
```

:::
